title: Merge K sorted lists (min-heap)

test_cases.call:
def mk(vs):
    if not vs:return None
    h=t=ListNode(vs[0])
    for v in vs[1:]:t.next=ListNode(v);t=t.next
    return h
def ls(h):
    r=[]
    while h:r.append(h.val);h=h.next
    return r
ls(Solution().merge_k_lists([mk([1,4,5]),mk([1,3,4]),mk([2,6])]))
